claim: Escrow funding of BB climbed 17.5%→58.5% in ~4 months (~10.3 pp/mo). The fee engine is migrating onto an unattested rail in real time — attest is a clocked catalyst, not a nice-to-have. Hold-until-H1b is partly this curve.
